# Trenston

> Founder & CEO Operating System. Run your business. Don't chase it.

Trenston is web software that puts a company's money, sales, team, tasks, and decisions in one place,
so the person running the company can see what changed, what needs a decision, and what can be handed off.
Built for founders and CEOs running real operations, from your first hire to your hundredth.

Trenston brings together what is happening across your company (money, sales, people, and day-to-day work) in one place, so you do not have to bounce between five tools or chase three people for a status update. It shows what needs a decision from you, lets you hand off what does not, and keeps a simple record of what happened.

## Who it is for

- Founders building the company: You are still close to the work, but you should not drown in status chasing. Trenston gives you the whole company in one view, and a clear picture to share with investors and your team, without hiring a chief of staff.
- Owner-operators and traditional businesses: Manufacturing, services, agencies, family companies. Trenston is built for running the operation, not a tool only venture-backed startups use.
- CEOs and leadership teams: From a handful of people to a full leadership bench. Finance, sales, ops, and production keep their own pages. You get one synthesized view.

## Main features

- Briefing: What changed, what needs a decision, and what you can hand off, synthesized from your live data every time you open it.
- Decision Center: Pending approvals ranked by impact. Trenston recommends which to tackle first and why.
- Ask Trenston: "What's our biggest risk this quarter?" answered from your financials and pipeline, not the internet.
- CEO Pack: A summary of growth, cash, team pulse, and open decisions, generated in one click, ready to share with your co-founders, investors, or leadership team.
- Departments (optional): Sales, Accounting & Finance, Production, Procurement, Legal, HR, and Engineering & Maintenance pages, turned on only when a company uses them.

## Integrations

- Google Calendar and Drive, on every plan (Trenston does not request any Gmail access)
- QuickBooks, Xero, and Slack, from Starter
- SAP Business One and HubSpot, from Growth
- Details: https://www.trenston.com/integrations

## Pricing

- Free: $0 (3 users): Small teams trying Trenston
- Starter: $15/mo (7 users): Small businesses
- Growth: $39/mo (20 users): Growing businesses
- Business: $99/mo (35 users): Larger companies

Paid plans (Starter, Growth, Business) include a 7-day free trial.
Billing is via Paddle. Cancel anytime from Billing.
Authoritative pricing: https://www.trenston.com/pricing

## Common questions

- Billing & cancellation: Paid plans include a 7-day free trial; cancel before it ends and you are not charged. Billing runs through Paddle, our merchant of record. Cancel anytime from Billing. It takes effect at the end of the current period, no refunds after payment.
- Security: Your workspace's data is isolated from every other company on Trenston. Google and accounting connections use OAuth (or, for SAP Business One, credentials you control). Trenston never stores your passwords.
- Setup time: No implementation team or onboarding call required. Create a workspace, connect Google or an accounting system (or skip it and enter data by hand), and Trenston starts building your first Briefing right away.
- Integrations: Google (Calendar & Drive) is on every plan, including Free. Starter adds QuickBooks, Xero, and Slack alerts. Growth and Business also add SAP Business One and HubSpot. Manual entry stays available everywhere.
